limitations: Operational labels use AI silver provenance.
N=3 and adjudication use one Gemini model; repeated judgments are correlated.
IndoBERT diagnostic outputs do not change the locked AI silver decisions.
Packaging performs no training, model promotion, student delivery, CTT or IRT.

scorePolicy.meaning: Initial difficulty score, not student ability or empirical IRT difficulty.

confidencePolicy.meaning: AI run agreement with final labels; not a calibrated probability of correctness.
confidencePolicy.denominator: Requested initial runs; failures and abstentions do not support a label.
confidencePolicy.adjudication: Determines final labels; not counted as an additional vote.
